item.tib: yang zab rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud mkha' 'gro snying gi thig le ste nges don nyi ma'i snying po
yang zab rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud mkha' 'gro snying gi thig le ste nges don nyi ma'i snying po
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snyingathig dgongs pa rang grol gyis (gyi) / nges don nyi ma'i snying po 'di ni/ thar pa byang chub bsgrub pa'i snying nor bsngags pa'i blo dang bcas te/ grogs kyis bskul 'tshal ngor rnal 'byor 'ja' tshon snying po bdag gis rgyal rong dmu rdo'i byang phyogs kyi grong khyer ka ling ka yi dbus su 'khod pa'i 'dus sde dga' ldan du sa rta zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes la brtsams pa bstan 'gro'i smin yon du gyur cig
